development_evidence.learning_rate_rule: lowest final E4 development mean MASE in actual N16284 seed0 grid, then independent seeds1/2 replication
development_evidence.epoch_rule: minimum mean development MASE across seeds0/1/2 at actual N16284 among predeclared half/integer observations
development_evidence.limitations: two-task development; mean gain does not imply every task improves; probability temperatures not frozen; safe-history diagnostics are not source-pool evidence
